chung.Syllabus Name: Business English Communication_Giao tiếp tiếng Anh trong kinh doanh
chung.Time Allocation: 124 hours online study + 3 hrs offline (2slots) + 1 hr exam + 22 hours self-study
chung.Description:
This course aims at shaping students' effective communication skills in professional contexts using English. The course helps students expand their vocabulary, improve both speaking and writing skills in English, and learn terminology and skills which can be applied in different business situations and contexts.

*Assessment scheme:

1) Ongoing assessment: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.

2) Theoretical Exam (TE)

3) Final Result (FR) =min (10, TE+ Bonus)

4) Completion Criteria: TE>=4 and FR>=5
chung.StudentTasks:
1. Join the online course (spec.) when being invited by the admin.

2. Enroll in each MOOC of spec., regularly study MOOCs at least 5hrs/week by watching videos, reading materials, taking quizzes, doing assgnments... as required

3. Respect the Coursera Code of Conduct, at https://learner.coursera.help/hc/en-us/articles/208280036-Coursera-Code-of-Conduct

3. Keep online learning progress promptly (bonus will be awarded)

4. Communicate and discuss in forum

5. Attend off-line sessions in the Campus

6. Must complete all MOOCs of spec. with certification in order to take the Final Exam at Campus

taiLieu: SPEC: Business English Communication Skills Specialization
clo:
Develop vocabulary and customs related to socializing and networking in English and apply them professionally in interaction with business contacts in different situations.
LO1.1 Evaluate your current level of proficiency in business English communication
LO1.2 Present relevant information about yourself in a discussion forum
LO1.3 Develop your networking skills
LO1.4 Write short emails with appropriate formatting
LO1.5 Recognize and produce formal and informal language in emails
LO1.6 Develop vocabulary related to jobs and companies

Develop vocabulary and skills related to meetings and apply them effectively in on-site meetings and teleconfrences.
LO2.1 Arrange a meeting through email and by telephone
LO2.2 List expectations and protocols related to on-site meetings and teleconferences
LO2.3 State phone numbers, dates, currencies, and sales figures accurately
LO2.4 Write a proposal with appropriate organization and vocabulary

Develop and apply language and strategies for successful negotiations.
LO3.1 Negotiate strategically in formal and informal settings
LO3.2 Identify and resolve customer issues after a negotiation has taken place.
LO3.3 Evaluate and compare services and features of two venues
LO3.4 Plan a business event using negotiation skills
LO3.5 Write an announcement for a business event after selecting a venue

Develop and apply language and techniques to make effective presentations in English.
LO4.1 Present information in an organized and engaging way
LO4.2 Use charts and graphs to share data
LO4.3 Use persuasive language in a presentation

Demonstrate the competence and ability to use appropriate language in different business contexts.
LO5.1 Use appropriate vocabulary to write a mini business plan
LO5.2 Communicate a business plan orally in an organized and engaging presentation
